description: This source file defines the ParagraphRenderInfo class, which encapsulates rendering information related to paragraphs within the MigraDoc PDF generation library. It manages format details, associated document objects, and provides functionality for layout adjustments.

classes.name: ParagraphRenderInfo
classes.description: A sealed class that extends RenderInfo, providing rendering details specific to a paragraph, including format info, associated document object, and layout management.

methods.name: RemoveEnding
methods.description: Removes ending formatting from the paragraph's format info and adjusts the layout content area height accordingly.
